title: EMOMEE launches first show on Netflix, marks global streaming debut 15 months after launch
raw_summary:
EMOMEE, the fast-growing children's entertainment brand helping children build life skills through its beloved characters, E, Mo & Mee, has officially launched its first show on Netflix.

Just 15 months after launch, EMOMEE has grown into one of India's fastest-rising preschool IPs, reaching families in over 100 countries, crossing more than a billion views, building a community of over 2.5 million subscribers, and earning national recognition on Shark Tank India, where the founders received offers from all five Sharks.

The Netflix launch marks EMOMEE’s global streaming debut and an important milestone in its ambition to build a world-class children’s entertainment franchise from India.

The first series, EMOMEE: Big Skills for Little Ones, Minis, features 20 curated 11-minute episodes that bring together the brand's most-loved stories around core life skills such as confidence, kindness, curiosity, emotional intelligence and problem-solving. Designed for preschoolers and their families, the series transforms everyday moments into engaging adventures that make learning life skills genuinely fun.

"This launch represents much more than a new distribution platform. It is another milestone in building EMOMEE into a global entertainment company. Every step we've taken - from growing a loyal audience to expanding onto streaming platforms - is helping us build a long-term franchise that will extend beyond content into consumer products, licensing and live experiences," said Pooja Jauhari, Founder & CEO of EMOMEE.

Built on the belief that entertainment can prepare children for the future, EMOMEE creates stories that help young audiences develop the life skills they'll need in an increasingly complex world. Every episode is designed around meaningful themes including resilience, communication, empathy, confidence and curiosity, wrapped in playful adventures that children love.

The Netflix launch is the latest step in EMOMEE's broader growth strategy as the company continues expanding its global footprint across streaming, live experiences, consumer products and licensing. Later this year, EMOMEE will showcase its growing slate and franchise ambitions at MIPCOM as it builds new international distribution and licensing partnerships.

title: Shantanu Maheshwari inspires young creators at Arena Animation’s Perspectives 2026 in Mumbai
raw_summary:
Arena Animation, a pioneer in animation, gaming, visual effects, and digital media education and a training brand of Aptech Limited, successfully concluded the Mumbai edition of Perspectives 2026, its flagship annual industry engagement platform, bringing together over 1000 students, industry professionals, creative leaders and renowned personalities from the Media & Entertainment ecosystem.

Celebrating 30 years of creative excellence, this year's edition was built around the theme of inspiring the next generation of creative professionals by connecting them with real-world industry perspectives, emerging artificial intelligence (AI) powered creative workflows, emerging technologies and career opportunities within the rapidly evolving AVGC-XR (Animation, Visual Effects, Gaming, Comics and Extended Reality) sector.

The event featured distinguished personalities including Dr. Amit Behl, acclaimed actor and television personality, Mr. Shantanu Maheshwari, a versatile actor, dancer and performer, Actor Aditya Deshmukh, a popular face across Marathi and Hindi entertainment, Mr. Vaibhav More, Director, Designer & Animator who delivered a special session on AI in Animation & VFX, Mr. Vineeth S, Country Manager – Media & Entertainment, Ark Infosolutions, along with Mr. Sandip Weling, Whole-time Director & Chief Business Officer, Global Retail Business, Aptech Limited and Mr. Shajan Samuel, Sr. Vice President & National Sales Head- (Arena Animation), Aptech Limited.

The day-long event blended industry learning with immersive student experiences through keynote sessions, AI demonstrations, celebrity interactions and talent showcases, reinforcing Arena Animation's commitment to nurturing industry-ready creative professionals.

Students gained first-hand insights into the evolving creative economy, the growing influence of AI in content creation, emerging industry skill requirements and career opportunities across animation, VFX, gaming, digital design and filmmaking. The celebrity interactions further inspired participants through personal stories of perseverance, career evolution and continuous learning.

Media & Entertainment Skills Council (MESC) collaborated as the Industry Partner and Huion as the Technology Partner for Perspectives 2026. These collaborations underscore Arena Animation's continued focus on building stronger industry-academia linkages, enhancing experiential learning and ensuring students gain exposure to evolving technologies, industry standards and career opportunities shaping India's rapidly growing AVGC-XR ecosystem.

Beyond industry interactions, Perspectives 2026 transformed into a vibrant student festival featuring Arena’s Got Talent, Cosplay Ramp Walk, interactive engagement activities, AI showcases and the popular Khau Gully Food Zone, providing students with multiple platforms to celebrate creativity, collaboration and self-expression.

The event also highlighted Arena Animation's strategic focus on strengthening industry-academia collaboration, integrating emerging technologies into learning and encouraging original intellectual property creation through initiatives such as Arena Animation Originals. These initiatives reflect the institute's vision of developing globally competitive creative professionals equipped with future-ready skills.

Mr. Sandip Weling, Whole-time Director & Chief Business Officer, Global Retail Business, Aptech Limited, said, "As Arena Animation celebrates three decades of shaping creative talent, Perspectives has evolved beyond an industry interaction into a platform where inspiration meets opportunity. The creative economy is witnessing rapid transformation with AI, immersive technologies and digital storytelling redefining how content is created. Through Perspectives 2026, we wanted our students to experience these changes first-hand by learning directly from industry leaders, technology experts and creative professionals who are shaping the future. Equally important was giving our students a stage to showcase their own creativity, confidence and passion. At Arena Animation, our endeavour is to create professionals who are not only technically proficient but also innovative, adaptable and globally employable."

Dr. Amit Behl, said, "The creative industry today offers immense opportunities for young people willing to learn, adapt and stay passionate about their craft. It was wonderful interacting with Arena Animation students who displayed remarkable enthusiasm and curiosity. Their creativity and energy reaffirm that India's next generation of storytellers, artists and creators is ready to make a global impact."

Mr. Shantanu Maheshwari added, "Every creative journey begins with a dream, but it is discipline, continuous learning and resilience that transform dreams into careers. Meeting these talented students and witnessing their passion through Arena’s Got Talent and other activities was truly inspiring. I hope they continue believing in themselves and embrace every opportunity that comes their way."

With India's AVGC-XR sector witnessing unprecedented growth and creative technology reshaping the future of entertainment, advertising, gaming and digital experiences, Arena Animation continues to strengthen its academic ecosystem by integrating AI-enabled workflows, industry collaborations and experiential learning into its curriculum.

As it marks 30 years of creative excellence, Arena Animation remains committed to empowering aspiring artists, designers, storytellers, animators and innovators with industry-relevant skills, global exposure and future-ready education, while contributing meaningfully to India's growing creative economy and AVGC-XR ecosystem.

title: Hansal Mehta-backed Birds in the Dark to premiere at Busan International Film Festival 2026
raw_summary:
Birds in the Dark (Hanere De Panchi), written, cinematographed, and directed by Shashank Walia, will have its World Premiere in the Vision section of the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF), running October 6–15, 2026.

Set in rural Punjab, Birds In The Dark is a narrative Punjabi film shot in black and white and also featuring dialects of Punjabi, Kashmiri and Urdu. Produced by Reema Kaur for Two Black Squares, and by Hansal Mehta and Sahil Saigal for True Story Films, this intersectional film takes you through various thematics across gender, caste, and class.

In line with Busan International Film Festival (BIFF)’s Vision section, Birds In The Dark (Hanere De Panchi) celebrates the independent spirit of Asian cinema, putting a spotlight on bold and personal storytelling of South Asian filmography.

On the film’s official selection, Director-Writer-Cinematographer Shashank Walia says, “Birds in the Dark emerges from the people and returns to them. This film was born from a desire to understand one another through mutual aid, care, and solidarity. It is in these acts that we discover what connects us, what is worth fighting for, and, ultimately, what sustains us; love."

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by @truestoryfilmsllp

Reema Kaur, who also served as the editor for this black and white narrative fiction as well as the Producer, reveals, “This film is our sincere attempt to portray the quiet, mundane rhythms of everyday life, and the resilience that lives within them. Living alongside the community, listening to their stories, and working with them to bring this story forth, we discovered the power of the collective. It has been a deeply humbling journey.

”This is my 3rd film at Busan (Aligarh and Omerta as Director), and I couldn’t be prouder making my debut as a producer at Busan with Shashank’s exquisitely meditative painting on gender, labour, justice and love,” states Producer Hansal Mehta.

"True Story Films has always looked to back distinct, director-driven voices alongside our mainstream work. Birds in the Dark (Hanere De Panchi) belongs on a stage like Busan, and we're proud to bring it there,” adds Producer Sahil Saigal.

Founded in 1996, the Busan International Film Festival is Korea's first film festival and one of Asia's most significant platforms for new cinema, serving as a cultural bridge between Asian filmmaking and the world.

title: Govinda warns of Rs 100 crores legal action over false marriage and divorce reports; flags deepfakes and AI content
raw_summary:
Govinda has reportedly warned of legal action against media organisations, digital platforms and content creators over what he describes as false, misleading and defamatory information concerning his personal and family life. The actor has also raised concerns over the use of digitally manipulated material, including deepfakes and AI-generated content.

The development comes after a series of reports and social media claims surrounding Govinda’s personal life. Following the appearance of his wife Sunita Ahuja at court, reports had surfaced claiming that she had withdrawn her alleged divorce case against the actor. Subsequently, rumours emerged alleging that Govinda had secretly married actress Rani Swarnkar in a court ceremony. Such claims have reportedly been described as untrue.

According to the public notice issued on Govinda’s behalf, the actor has cautioned the public, media organisations, digital platforms and content creators against creating, publishing, uploading, circulating or sharing any false, defamatory, malicious, fabricated or unverified material concerning him or his family.

The notice also specifically addresses digitally manipulated content. It reportedly includes photographs, videos, audio recordings, morphed images, deepfakes and AI-generated material. According to the notice, no permission has been granted to create, manipulate or use Govinda’s voice, photographs, identity or likeness, particularly in relation to his private or family life, through artificial intelligence or other digital technologies.

The actor has also cited his past experiences and expressed concerns over what he believes could be a deliberate campaign aimed at damaging his public image. The notice warns that legal proceedings could be initiated under applicable provisions relating to defamation, privacy violations, misuse of identity and cybercrime, including provisions under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, and the Information Technology Act, 2000, along with other relevant laws.

As part of the warning, Govinda has reportedly threatened civil claims of up to Rs 100 crores against individuals or entities allegedly responsible for creating or disseminating such content. The notice further states that he may pursue additional legal remedies before the courts, including measures concerning bank accounts, restrictions relating to property transactions and seizure of passports, subject to applicable law.

The notice also calls for action against YouTube channels and social media accounts allegedly found to be deliberately publishing or circulating false and misleading information about the actor and his family.

The latest development comes amid continued public speculation surrounding Govinda’s personal life, with the actor now signalling that he intends to take a legal route to address what he considers unauthorised and misleading reporting and digitally manipulated content.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Trailer of Akshay Kumar-Saif Ali Khan starrer Haiwaan to release digitally on August 25
raw_summary:
On August 12, the teaser of the much-awaited thriller Haiwaan was launched, followed by the launch of the song 'Mere Hero Hai Woh'. There’s been a huge demand among the audience to see the trailer. Bollywood Hungama has learned that netizens won’t have to wait long, as the trailer will be released in less than 24 hours.

A source told Bollywood Hungama, “The trailer of Haiwaan will be released tomorrow, Tuesday, August 25. While the teaser offered just a glimpse into the film’s dark and thrilling world, ‘Mere Hero Hai Woh’ shed light on an important emotional track in the story. The trailer will now open up the world of Haiwaan further and give audiences a much clearer sense of the conflict, particularly the intriguing equation between Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan’s characters. The rest of the ensemble cast is also expected to get its due in the trailer. The makers are extremely confident about the asset and believe that it will significantly amplify the buzz around the film ahead of its September 11 release.”

Besides Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, Haiwaan also stars Boman Irani, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Saiyami Kher, Rajpal Yadav, Sharib Hashmi, Rajesh Sharma, Pahal Chaudhary and Manoj Joshi. It is directed by Priyadarshan. Incidentally, this is the second film of Priyadarshan and Akshay Kumar this year. Their last film, Bhooth Bangla (2026), was a horror comedy and hence totally diverse from the space of Haiwaan.

Recently, Priyadarshan spoke highly of Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan. Regarding Saif, he said, “Saif made the character his own. I didn’t have to explain much. He just listened, understood, and delivered beyond expectation. When he came to me, I told him to open his eyes, and without blinking, to think that he cannot see. Saif told me that he had never heard such a simple explanation before.”

As for Akshay Kumar, Priyadarshan stated, “Akshay’s character is not grey; he is a psycho in Haiwaan.” He added that their long-standing professional relationship has created a strong level of trust, allowing Akshay to perform without repeatedly questioning his direction.

title: Don’t Be Shy: Alia Bhatt-produced rom-com to premiere on Prime Video on September 25
raw_summary:
Prime Video has announced September 25, 2026, as the worldwide premiere date for its upcoming Prime Original Movie Don’t Be Shy. Written and directed by Sreeti Mukerji, the coming-of-age romantic comedy is produced by Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt under their banner, Eternal Sunshine Productions. Grishma Shah and Vikesh Bhutani have co-produced the film.

The film introduces four young actors—Aarushi Bajaj, Ansh Duggal, Bianca Arora and Piyush Khati—as they navigate friendship, young love, heartbreak, ambitions and the uncertainties that come with growing up. The cast also includes Kunaal Roy Kapur, Anurag Basu, Neha Dhupia and Anju Alva Naik in pivotal roles.

"Don't Be Shy is one of our most cherished films, and we're thrilled to finally announce its global streaming premiere," said Nikhil Madhok, Director and Head of Originals, Prime Video (SVOD) and Amazon MGM Studios India. "This film introduces four extraordinary new actors—Aarushi, Ansh, Bianca, and Piyush—who bring an incredible freshness and authenticity to their roles. Led by Sreeti Mukerji and shaped by the creative vision of Alia and Shaheen Bhatt, Don’t Be Shy is a joyful, heartfelt celebration of friendship, love, and the beautifully messy journey of growing up. We can’t wait for audiences to immerse themselves in Shy’s world.”

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by prime video IN (@primevideoin)

Sharing their thoughts on the film, Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt, co-founders of Eternal Sunshine Productions, said in a joint statement, "Don't Be Shy has been extremely special to us from the very beginning, and we couldn’t be prouder to see it come to life. It captures something so honest about being young—the friendships that shape you, the first loves that change you, the heartbreaks that stay with you, and the process of gradually figuring out who you are. What excites us most is this brilliant young cast; their energy, vulnerability, and chemistry are magnetic, and they bring such life and honesty to these characters. We can’t wait for audiences in India and around the world to meet Shy and get swept into her wonderful, chaotic world,”

Don’t Be Shy will stream exclusively on Prime Video in Hindi with English subtitles. The film will be available across India and more than 240 countries and territories worldwide from September 25, 2026.

title: 1942: A Love Story gets limited theatrical run after makers flag technical issues at certain cinemas
raw_summary:
Vidhu Vinod Chopra Films has announced that the restored version of 1942: A Love Story will now be screened only at select cinemas following an overwhelming response to its theatrical re-release. The production house said the decision has been taken to ensure audiences experience the film in the technical quality intended by the restoration team. The film returned to theatres on August 21 in a meticulously restored version, with audiences revisiting the 1994 romantic drama on the big screen.

Makers to screen restored version at select theatres In a statement addressed to audiences and cinema lovers, Vidhu Vinod Chopra Films said it had received a large number of messages from viewers praising the film's theatrical experience over the weekend. The production house explained that the film was restored in 8K resolution with Dolby 5.1 surround sound. However, it subsequently found that some cinema halls were not technically equipped to project the restoration in its intended quality.

The makers have therefore decided to limit the theatrical run to "handpicked theatres" that meet the required technical standards. The production house said it does not want to compromise on the quality of the restoration and wants audiences to experience the film "at its absolute best." Viewers have also been asked to check the updated cinema list to find the participating theatres in their city.

Two-year restoration involved over 9,000 human hours The restoration of 1942: A Love Story was carried out over nearly two years in Bologna, Italy, and at Prasad Film Labs. According to the production house, more than 150 people worked on the restoration, contributing over 9,000 human hours to the project. The iconic soundtrack alone reportedly required more than 300 hours of work from the restoration team to remaster it.

The filmmakers also noted that while India currently has 4K cinemas, the restoration has been created with future viewing in mind, allowing audiences to revisit the film in high quality in the years to come.

Directed by Vidhu Vinod Chopra, 1942: A Love Story stars Anil Kapoor, Manisha Koirala, Jackie Shroff and Anupam Kher in pivotal roles. The film is produced by Vidhu Vinod Chopra, with music composed by R. D. Burman and lyrics written by Javed Akhtar.

title: Arshad Warsi starrer Jeevan Bheema Yojana locks September 4 release
raw_summary:
Arshad Warsi is set to take on his first-ever double role on the big screen with Jeevan Bheema Yojana, which will now release worldwide in cinemas on September 4, 2026.

The film was earlier scheduled to hit theatres on August 28. The makers have now confirmed September 4 as the final theatrical release date, as the film enters the final phase of its promotional campaign. A new poster announcing the release date has also been unveiled.

Directed by Abhishek Dogra, Jeevan Bheema Yojana features Arshad Warsi in two contrasting roles — Jeevan and Bheema. The cast also includes Sanjeeda Shaikh, Vijay Raaz, Pooja Chopra, Bijendra Kala and the late Atul Parchure.

Presented and produced by Starbeam Ventures Limited (formerly Blue God Entertainment Limited), the film blends dark comedy, crime and suspense against the backdrop of an unusual case of mistaken identity.

The story revolves around Jeevan, a debt-ridden common man whose life changes after he encounters his dangerous lookalike, Bheema. What initially seems like an opportunity soon turns into a series of chaotic events, pushing the characters into a complicated web of lies, greed and risky decisions.

Sanjeeda Shaikh plays Yojana, Jeevan’s sharp and resourceful wife, while Vijay Raaz portrays the mysterious Vinayak.

Talking about the film, director Abhishek Dogra said, “Jeevan Bheema Yojana is a film about ordinary people making one extraordinary, catastrophic decision and then spending the rest of the film paying for it. The genre is dark comedy, but the heart of it is very human. Arshad brings both men to life with a precision that constantly surprised us on set.”

The film marks a first for Arshad Warsi, who plays two distinctly different characters in the same project.

With its release date now confirmed, Jeevan Bheema Yojana is set to arrive in cinemas worldwide on September 4, 2026, bringing together dark humour, crime, suspense and mistaken identity.

title: Akshay Kumar begins shooting for Vipul Amrutlal Shah's alien action thriller Samuk
raw_summary:

The actor has begun shooting for his much-awaited survival-action thriller Samuk, marking the reunion of him and producer-filmmaker Vipul Amrutlal Shah for their seventh collaboration. Directed by Kanishk Varma, the film has gone on floors in London and is being mounted as a large-scale Pan-India theatrical release with global production ambitions.

According to industry sources, Akshay Kumar began filming for Samuk on August 23, 2026. As per an earlier report by Variety, the shooting was expected to commence in London as the makers are expected to shoot approximately 90 per cent of the film in the England capital, with the remaining portions planned in Mumbai. The production is being executed as one continuous schedule rather than being divided into multiple shooting legs.

The film, which has been in development for over two years, combines military realism, survival horror and alien mythology. The makers have brought together an international technical team to create the world of Samuk, including Academy Award-nominated creature effects designer Alec Gillis, who has worked on major creature-driven franchises including Alien and Predator. Gillis has designed the central alien creature for the film.

With filming now underway in London, Samuk is gearing up as one of Akshay Kumar’s most ambitious upcoming theatrical projects, bringing together a homegrown action star, an international creature-design team and a survival thriller set against an alien backdrop.

They believe that their film carries tremendous excitement and hence feel justified in their demand.”

The source further said, “Irumudi did very well over the weekend and even on Monday, its collections hardly dropped. In fact, the film continued to collect in double digits. This, coupled with Toxic’s mid-week release, has further complicated the scenario. Less than 24 hours are left for the release of Toxic, and the show plans for both films for Wednesday are yet to be finalized.”
